claim: EV-0050 records the bounded CP21 child-side Triton vecadd compile/provenance gate. It binds the unmodified tutorial and fixed HSACO identities, validates the AMDGPU metadata including the Triton unknown-gfx950 target spelling and descriptor preload DWORD count, and performs caller-local code/kernarg preparation. This gate does not invoke the Triton compiler or JIT, normal-launch the tutorial, upload or transport an image, execute ISA, or count CPU/NVIDIA fallback.
command_argv:
set -eu
python3 - <<"PY"
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("projects/self-amdgpu-runtime")
expected = [
    "src/code_object.c",
    "tests/CMakeLists.txt",
    "tests/triton_vecadd_compile_test.c",
    "tools/sagr-triton-hsaco-probe.c",
]
status = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "-C", str(root), "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"],
    text=True,
)
status_paths = []
for line in status.splitlines():
    if line:
        status_paths.append(line[3:])
assert sorted(status_paths) == sorted(expected), status_paths
check = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--check"],
    text=True,
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
)
assert check.returncode == 0, check.stdout
tracked_diff = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--binary", "--full-index", "--", *expected]
)
hasher = hashlib.sha256()
hasher.update(tracked_diff)
hasher.update(b"\\0UNTRACKED:tests/triton_vecadd_compile_test.c\\0")
hasher.update((root / "tests/triton_vecadd_compile_test.c").read_bytes())
files = {}
for relative in expected:
    payload = (root / relative).read_bytes()
    files[relative] = {"bytes": len(payload), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}
print(json.dumps({
    "child": str(root),
    "base_head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "base_tree": subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip(),
    "status_paths": sorted(status_paths),
    "diff_check": "pass",
    "tracked_diff_bytes": len(tracked_diff),
    "working_diff_sha256": hasher.hexdigest(),
    "files": files,
    "scope": "compile/provenance-only; no root/state/docs/transaction edits"
}, sort_keys=True))
PY

python3 - <<"PY"
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def digest(path):
    payload = path.read_bytes()
    return len(payload), hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

tutorial = Path("projects/triton/python/tutorials/01-vector-add.py")
hsaco = Path("artifacts/evidence/CP-0017/triton-builds/vecadd-gfx950.hsaco")
tutorial_size, tutorial_sha = digest(tutorial)
hsaco_size, hsaco_sha = digest(hsaco)
hsaco_bytes = hsaco.read_bytes()
assert tutorial_size > 0
assert hsaco_size == 5408
assert tutorial_sha == "842430949e0ccde4fbce07606cce3ac4bac36bf21b2b12619a31b795ca4029b3"
assert hsaco_sha == "ee8b0f892da7ab1886f17ee66f88de5c23e05a48f7f361e02bd0707c9a11826e"
triton_status = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "-C", "projects/triton", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"],
    text=True,
)
assert triton_status == ""
raw_target = b"amdgcn-amd-amdhsa-unknown-gfx950"
assert hsaco_bytes.count(raw_target) >= 1
# The pinned ELF places vecadd.kd at .rodata file offset 0x5c0.
descriptor = hsaco_bytes[0x5c0:0x5c0 + 64]
assert len(descriptor) == 64
preload_dwords = int.from_bytes(descriptor[58:60], "little")
assert preload_dwords == 12
symbols = subprocess.check_output(
    ["readelf", "-Ws", "--wide", str(hsaco)], text=True
)
vecadd_lines = [line.strip() for line in symbols.splitlines() if " vecadd" in line]
assert any("FUNC    GLOBAL PROTECTED" in line and line.endswith(" vecadd") for line in vecadd_lines)
assert any("OBJECT  GLOBAL DEFAULT" in line and line.endswith(" vecadd.kd") for line in vecadd_lines)
print(json.dumps({
    "tutorial": {"path": str(tutorial), "bytes": tutorial_size, "sha256": tutorial_sha, "unmodified_triton_status": True},
    "hsaco": {"path": str(hsaco), "bytes": hsaco_size, "sha256": hsaco_sha, "target": raw_target.decode(), "descriptor_file_offset": "0x5c0", "descriptor_bytes": 64, "descriptor_kernarg_preload_dwords": preload_dwords, "descriptor_preload_semantics": "DWORD count; not bytes", "code_symbol_visibility": "GLOBAL PROTECTED", "descriptor_symbol_visibility": "GLOBAL DEFAULT"},
    "compiler_invoked": False,
    "jit": False,
    "runtime_execution": False,
    "fallback": False
}, sort_keys=True))
PY

command_results.result: The unmodified tutorial and pinned HSACO identities, exact target spelling, symbol visibility, and descriptor preload DWORD count are independently checked.

limitations: This is a child-only metadata/provenance gate; it does not invoke Triton or LLVM in this run. The tutorial source and HSACO are hash inputs from the prior pinned compile artifact.

The parser accepts the exact amdgcn-amd-amdhsa-unknown-gfx950 spelling and DEFAULT-visible vecadd.kd only for this metadata-only Triton boundary; the kernel code symbol remains GLOBAL PROTECTED and ISA support remains false.

Materialization and zero-initialized 48-byte kernarg packing are caller-local preparation. No PT_LOAD mapping, GPU virtual address assignment, AQL launch, wire upload, queue submission, simulator execution, output differential, or performance evidence is present.
The descriptor preload field is recorded as a 16-bit DWORD count of 12 (48 bytes), not as a byte count. Normal Triton launcher and transport remain blocked and no fallback path is enabled.

Normal launcher and end-to-end execution remain unclaimed.
